name: Greek Salad with Cucumber, Bell Pepper, Tomato, Feta & Olives
instructions: Place oil, vinegar, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and slice shallot crosswise into thin half moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing and stir to coat. Set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Large dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing and shallot.
Trim, seed, and large dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl.
Trim and large dice cucumber. Add to the bowl.
Halve olives lengthwise. Add to the bowl, along with the feta, and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between bowls and enjoy!
author: Mealime
